svg.title: Gate 1: the initial approval
svg.desc: The owner completes four assessments in parallel; their answers decide who else is asked; the approvals run in parallel; the asset moves on to development or procurement.
svg.text: May we build or buy it? The owner completes four assessments; the answers decide who else is asked; the approvals run in parallel.
The owner starts it: a button,
With the risk class: the change materiality and the
Only for a conditional or autonomous agent: access,
Read, generated or inferred; special categories;
no: settled by rule, and recorded
declared none: not asked, and the
Light: no test scope at Gate 1
Reviews the asset, its documentation, the assessments
One request per component: allow, allow with
conditions, or reject with a reason.
Confirms whether a DPIA is required; usually approves
on condition of a DPIA before go-live.
Reviews the authority statement; sets the test scope,
The CISO, Risk and Compliance / Legal sign off
The change materiality and the path, with its reviews and sign-offs
The minimum controls of its level of autonomy
The test scope, with the metrics and thresholds it must meet
Conditions, with an owner and a date
For a Medium or Significant change: the change risk assessment, opened in [the GRC tool]
A fact not known gives “cannot classify: fact unknown”, never a low class
An unknown is never read as a no: the step it guards runs
The approver is not the requester
Questions go in the asset's conversation; whoever approved is told what changed since
The owner may cancel: the asset returns to where it stood
A reminder before a task is due, a notice when it is late
